system.description: Your third eye can occasionally perceive things invisible to normal sight. You have no control over what the eye sees, and this additional vision can bring trouble as often as insight — perhaps sight through Obfuscate, Chimerstry, or magical illusions, glimpses into the Shadowlands, or a faerie's true form. The third eye must be open for this Merit to function, whether through Valeren or a concentrated effort (Willpower, difficulty 6).
system.source: Clanbook: Salubri (Dark Ages), Chapter Four: The Powers of the Righteous
